projects.title: Cox Automotive
projects.label: Enterprise software
projects.summary: Designing the CRM and AI experiences that connect dealership teams.
projects.detail: Product leadership, research, interface design, and AI engineering for VinSolutions CRM.
projects.body:
PRINCIPAL PRODUCT DESIGNER · VINSOLUTIONS

Re-architecting the CRM.
Designing the role of AI.

I led designers and researchers through a fundamental CRM rebuild, pairing enterprise product direction with hands-on design and front-end work. The CRM product alone generates nearly $300 million in annual revenue. A core UI that had gone nearly 15 years without a major refresh became the focus of a research-led, responsive redesign—with AI woven into the workflow.

Users involved in research
3,291
Over 18 months
Dealerships represented
Hundreds
Across the United States
CRM pages in scope
Hundreds
Architecture, UI, and responsiveness
Planning horizon
~2 years
Coordinating a complex transformation
Research to product ↓ UI + AI experience ↓ Leading the work ↓

RESEARCH TO PRODUCT

Evidence shaped the architecture.

I visited dealerships nationwide, working directly with senior stakeholders and the people using the CRM every day. Research informed feature discovery, user journeys, and page architecture throughout the rebuild.

The system grew from a custom MUI / Material UI theme, extensively modified for the brand and the demands of dealership workflows.

Download diagram

UI + AI EXPERIENCE

Two ways in. One connected workflow.

My view: UI and AI work best together. Let people choose direct interaction or an AI-assisted path, according to what gets the task done most effectively.

Accuracy and regulatory requirements shaped AI behavior and communication flows, alongside the goal of shorter, simpler workflows.

Download diagram

LEADING THE WORK

Lead the team. Take on the hard problems.

I assigned myself some of the most complex UI work while setting direction, coaching the team, and expanding how we designed, researched, and built with AI.

Design-system connections and AI workflows were developed within Cox Automotive’s security requirements.

Download diagram
How research grounded the AI workflow

We used existing research to guide synthesis and evaluate UI alternatives. Digital twins and synthetic users helped surface potential issues before on-site sessions; they were tools for exploration, not substitutes for evidence from real people. This let us use dealership research time more deliberately.

ACROSS PRODUCT BOUNDARIES

Connecting the CRM to Fullpath’s CDP.

I also led UI/UX integration across systems with overlapping AI messaging and summarization capabilities.

Explore the Fullpath work →

FUTURE PLATFORM

A connected dealership experience.

These future-platform concepts bring customer context, sales, service, inventory, and AI assistance into a shared experience. Executive Summary establishes the visual direction across the platform.

CORE CRM

Rebuilding the customer record.

The core CRM rebuild brings customer information, AI summaries, active leads, appointments, and vehicle context together.

SIDEBAR & MOBILE

Details in the flow of work.

Focused sidebar and mobile experiences support AI queries, vehicle evaluation, lead activity, and team collaboration.

projects.label: Product & design systems
projects.summary: A consistent product experience across baggage identification and operations.
projects.detail: Brand, product design, design systems, and front-end development for AI-powered baggage identification.
projects.body:
VP OF UX · BRAND, RESEARCH & PRODUCT DELIVERY

From the first logo
to a working AI platform.

I lead a team of developers and designers as VP of UX. I created the initial brand and first UIs solo, built the design system in both design and front-end code, and continue contributing directly—especially on the hardest problems.

THE WORKFLOW

One vision, from identity to operations.

Discovery with prospective users, airlines, airports, and TSA informed the interfaces we built and demonstrated in real working conditions.

Download workflow

THE PRODUCT EXPERIENCE

Recognize the bag. Connect the journey.

BagsID identifies baggage from its visual characteristics—color, type, dimensions, scratches, and stickers—without requiring an RFID tag or a manual barcode scan.

Download experience map

THE WORK, IN PRACTICE

The identity, components, website, films, and product screens below show how that approach carries through into delivery.

CORPORATE VISUAL IDENTITY

One identity. Every touchpoint.

I created the BagsID corporate visual identity: a shared visual language for the brand, its digital experiences, and its marketing. The system covers the logo, colour palette, typography, layout, imagery, motion, and practical templates.

I produced marketing across digital and physical formats: business cards, tablecloths, full-size conference booths, and campaign materials. I also helped brand our custom scanning arches and designed custom kiosk interfaces, carrying the identity into the operating environment.

Corporate visual identityWebsite design & buildMarketing videoNarration

THE CURRENT WEBSITE

The identity, in use.

I designed and built the current BagsID website, bringing the CVI into a complete digital experience. The site introduces the platform and its BagBridge and CarryOn products for airport and airline audiences.

Visit BagsID ↗

MARKETING FILM

The brand has a voice.

I create custom video and audio productions for product demonstrations at national and international conferences. The film featured on the BagsID homepage is part of that work; I also narrated it.

Narration: Lawrence Railey

Watch on the BagsID homepage ↗

SECURE SIGHT

Visibility across the baggage journey.

Secure Sight product screens and dashboard concepts bring baggage tracking, identification confidence, and camera history into a shared operational view.

CARRYON

Cabin baggage, in context.

CarryOn product screens connect flight operations with cabin baggage capacity, video monitoring, and flight configuration.

DESIGN SYSTEM · SOLO DESIGN & ENGINEERING

From brand identity to working components.

I designed the BagsID design system solo, before AI-assisted workflows, and tied it directly to the corporate brand identity I created. I also wrote most of the application UI code before AI-assisted coding, including the React component library built on MUI.

That hands-on foundation lets me develop front ends both independently and with AI tools. I bring my own JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and MUI expertise to the work, whether writing the code directly or using AI to accelerate implementation.

The Figma library covers reusable interface controls, navigation patterns, widgets, and charts. It connects the brand’s visual language with the components used to build product experiences.

projects.body:
GREENFIELD STARTUP · BRAND TO FRONT-END DELIVERY

One foundation.
Two purpose-built products.

I created the Loan AI brand, supporting website, and design system. Working with product stakeholders and end users, I helped architect two products, designed their interfaces, and delivered all of the front-end development for both.

Brand + websiteDesign system + researchUI + front-end development

Consulting period: October 2025 — October 2026

THE BUILD WORKFLOW

Design the system. Build the products.

The aim was a substantially simpler lending experience: clear interfaces and task-specific AI working together. In a greenfield startup, I could connect the brand, research, and reusable components directly to working code.

Download build workflow

AI IN THE PRODUCT + THE PROCESS

Specialized intelligence. Faster delivery.

Loan AI runs on a custom AI platform designed expressly for lending, rather than a general-purpose Claude or GPT integration. Claude, GPT, and other AI tools played a separate role in how I designed and developed the applications.

Download AI approach

PRODUCT · DESKTOP & MOBILE

Inside the lending workspace.

I developed the front-end for every Loan AI application, combining my own expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and MUI with Claude and other AI development tools.

The interfaces bring loan complexity, officer workload, and AI model oversight into desktop and mobile workflows.

JavaScript / TypeScriptReactMUIAI-assisted development

The login experience carries that identity into the product, while layered document and workforce illustrations make the platform’s subject matter tangible.

PRODUCT ARCHITECTURE · CROSS-TEAM LEADERSHIP

Bringing CRM and CDP together.

I led designers, researchers, and UI developers across Fullpath and VinSolutions, shaping a staged integration of the CDP into our CRM products. I also contributed directly, taking on some of the most complex architecture and UX problems myself.

750+Dealerships in
Fullpath’s CDP

THE INTEGRATION JOURNEY

Connect now. Integrate over time.

I created an architecture that brought Fullpath experiences into the CRM early, while defining a path toward deeper integration. Research with dealerships and users of both products informed each horizon.

Download integration journey

DATA + AI OPPORTUNITIES

Design around the strengths of both.

I designed AI summarization experiences and examined how Fullpath’s capabilities could improve our GenAI product. In parallel, we explored how richer CRM lead data could inform the CDP and where our virtual contact assistant could fit.

Download opportunity map

LEADING THE INTEGRATION

One direction across two product teams.

Align the teams

Lead UX designers, researchers, and UI developers across Fullpath and VinSolutions.

Connect the systems

Bring disparate design systems, customer journeys, and overlapping AI experiences together.

Stay hands-on

projects.summary: Enterprise tools and digital experiences for complex healthcare operations.
projects.detail: Product design and front-end development across enterprise web and mobile applications.
projects.body:
RESEARCH · ARCHITECTURE · DESIGN LEADERSHIP

Leading the experience across products.

For several years, I was responsible for research, experience architecture, and design across Healthesystems’ core Vertice product, Jurnē mobile product, corporate website, and related marketing. I led a team of designers and developers while continuing to do much of the work myself as a senior individual contributor.

Corporate website & front-end development

I personally designed and built the entire corporate website, completing a responsive WordPress rebuild in 2021 with custom PHP, Oxygen, and purpose-built plugins. My broader front-end work included specialized kiosk sites and UIs, alongside experience design for RxInformer and the MedMonitor medication-search experience.

Visit Healthesystems ↗

ENTERPRISE PRODUCT DESIGN

Vertice — making complexity usable.

Over roughly four years, I led research, experience architecture, and design for Healthesystems’ primary enterprise product for workers’ compensation. I guided designers and developers while personally researching and designing complex workflows, helping rebuild hundreds of screens and establish a new product identity.

Research that changed the interaction.

For complex authorizations, research pointed toward a narrative approach: expressing the action as a sentence instead of an unexplained collection of fields. Other workflows used guided steps, while contextual help offered relevant screenshots, videos, and field-level guidance.

The 2.5 and 3.0 interface releases were associated with approximately 5% and 3% increases in application usage, respectively.

Project archive · Screens and concepts from the original engagement.

Jurnē — mobile healthcare

I led research, experience architecture, and design for Jurnē, a mobile product for injured workers and claims adjusters spanning appointments, pharmacy pickups, billing, and related services. Alongside directing the team, I personally designed workflows and interfaces and contributed to UI development.

Project archive · Screens and concepts from the original engagement.

Supporting the product beyond the screen.

My responsibilities also extended to product and corporate marketing materials, conference booth designs, and video production. I connected these experiences to the same product story, supporting how Healthesystems explained and demonstrated its work to customers.

Clinical survey reports

Supported data collection and created custom digital landing pages for annual industry research. The 2019, 2020, and 2021 report experiences combined editorial content, data presentation, and front-end development.

writing:
FICTION & WORLD BUILDING

Cyber Byzantium.

Visit the world ↗

PUBLISHED · AVAILABLE ON AMAZON

Thirty Pieces of Silver.

An empire that never fell. The opening book in Spirits in the Silicon is available on Amazon.

Spirits in the Silicon is an alternate-history cyberpunk sequence I’m creating with Travis J. I. Corcoran. In this world, the Roman Empire survives into an age of electricity, cybernetics, relic hunters, and neon-lit Constantinople.

The project brings together fiction, Byzantine history, cover design, and AI art. I build the visual language alongside the world itself, developing custom Stable Diffusion extensions and checkpoints as part of that creative practice.

Thirty Pieces of Silver begins the sequence. Divine Transmission and Heretics of the Catacombs continue the world’s development.

Available on Amazon ↗Explore the books, world & gallery ↗

NOVELS IN PROGRESS

Dawn Nebula.

Dawn Nebula is a science-fantasy series I’m writing, exploring space, empire, and imagined futures. These are books in progress; the cover artwork is part of developing their worlds and bringing the stories to life.
music:
FLORIDA REGIME

Made for another kind of connection.

DJ. Producer. Audio engineer.

I’ve DJed across Central Florida since 1999, originally as DJ Dystopic, and produced electronic music as Xealot. In 2021, I brought those identities together as Florida Regime, with a focus on trance, tropical house, and synthwave.

That history includes Ybor City venues such as The Castle, Honeypot, and Gaspar’s Grotto, as well as outdoor events and livestreams. Sound, lighting, visual identity, and performance are all parts of the experience.

Alongside music production and mastering, I offer voiceover services for videos, product explainers, and audiobooks. Recording, editing, and a finished mix are all part of the work.
